specification.project_summary: Build a web portal for patients to book doctor appointments, view upcoming visits, and receive reminders. Admins need to manage doctor schedules.

features.name: Patient appointment booking
features.description: Patients can book doctor appointments through the web portal

features.name: View upcoming visits
features.description: Patients can view their upcoming medical visits

features.name: Receive reminders
features.description: Patients receive reminders for their appointments

features.name: Admin doctor schedule management
features.description: Admins can manage doctor schedules

assumptions: The web portal will be a single application serving both patients and admins
Reminders will be sent via email or SMS (not specified in input)
Doctor schedules are managed by admins through a web interface (not explicitly stated but implied by 'admin needs to manage doctor schedules')
open_questions: What specific types of reminders are required (email, SMS, in-app notifications)?
How will the system handle appointment conflicts (e.g., double bookings)?
What is the time frame for sending reminders (e: 24 hours before appointment)?
What authentication method will be used for patients and admins?
How will the system handle doctor availability (e.g., working hours, holidays)?

specification.project_summary: Internal tool for warehouse staff to scan barcodes, log incoming stock, deduct dispatched items, and get low-stock alerts when quantity drops below a threshold.

features.name: Barcode scanning
features.description: For warehouse staff to scan barcodes

features.name: Log incoming stock
features.description: Record stock received into the system

features.name: Deduct dispatched items
features.description: Remove stock when items are dispatched

features.name: Low-stock alerts
features.description: Alert when quantity drops below a threshold

assumptions: The tool is intended to be used by warehouse staff in a physical warehouse environment
The threshold for low-stock alerts is a configurable value (not explicitly stated but implied by 'drops below a threshold')
The system must handle real-time stock adjustments (implied by 'deduct dispatched items' and 'log incoming stock')
open_questions: What is the specific threshold value for low-stock alerts? (e.g., 5% of total stock, fixed number, etc.)
How will the system handle concurrent stock adjustments (e.g., multiple staff scanning items at the same time)?
What is the source of the barcode data (e.g., product database, external system)?
Is the low-stock alert threshold per product or for the entire warehouse?

specification.project_summary: Sales agents need a dashboard to capture property inquiries, assign leads to agents, log call notes, and filter leads by status (New, Contacted, Viewing Scheduled, Closed).

features.name: Capture property inquiries
features.description: Sales agents need to capture property inquiries

features.name: Assign leads to agents
features.description: Sales agents need to assign leads to agents

features.name: Log call notes
features.description: Sales agents need to log call notes

features.name: Filter leads by status
features.description: Sales agents need to filter leads by status (New, Contacted, Viewing Scheduled, Closed)

assumptions: The dashboard must be accessible to sales agents
The status values (New, Contacted, Viewing Scheduled, Closed) are predefined and used in the system

specification.project_summary: Customers can select a date, party size, and time slot to reserve a table. Restaurant managers can block peak hours and mark reservations as seated or no-show.

user_stories.goal: Pick a date, party size, and time slot to reserve a table
user_stories.benefit: Reserve a table for their party

user_stories.goal: Mark reservations as seated or no-show
user_stories.benefit: Track reservation status for operational purposes

assumptions: Peak hours are defined by the restaurant manager (e.g., specific time ranges or days of the week)
Reservations are blocked by the restaurant manager for peak hours, meaning those time slots are unavailable for new reservations
Marking a reservation as 'seated' or 'no-show' is a status update that affects the reservation's availability
open_questions: How are peak hours defined? (e.g., specific time ranges, days of the week, or based on historical data?)
What is the process for a restaurant manager to block peak hours? (e.g., manual entry, automated based on certain conditions?)
How does the system determine if a reservation is 'seated' or 'no-show'? (e.g., staff confirmation, timeout after a certain period?)
Are there any constraints on the number of party sizes or time slots that can be reserved?

specification.project_summary: Dispatchers assign delivery orders to drivers. Drivers update delivery status to Picked Up, In Transit, or Delivered and capture customer signature or photo proof.

features.name: Status updates
